name: Obligo
positioning: The new standard for security deposits — flexible options for renters, simplified operations for properties.
description: Obligo is a security-deposit alternative platform. It verifies a renter's eligibility and presents deposit options — no deposit, reduced deposit, installments, or a full deposit that earns interest — backed by a payment method on file instead of cash held by the property. At move-out, Obligo handles any charges and refunds digitally rather than by paper check.
real_estate_use: A property replaces its cash security-deposit requirement with Obligo: at lease signing, the renter connects a payment method and Obligo verifies their eligibility for a reduced or no-deposit option instead of the property collecting and holding a deposit itself. At move-out, if damage or unpaid charges apply, Obligo processes the charge against the renter's connected payment method and returns any remaining balance electronically, without the property having to manage a held deposit and its refund.
features: Digital move-out charge and refund processing

use_cases.job: Offer applicants a no-deposit or reduced-deposit option instead of collecting a cash deposit
Move out with charges and refunds settled digitally against a connected payment method instead of a paper check
